claims.summary: For the Fejer kernel K_L(t) = 2(1 - cos Lt)/(L t^2), 0 < s <= 2 pi/L and every real tau: the sum over integers j of K_L(tau - j s) equals 2 pi/s.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Poisson summation, the transform of K_L being the triangle 2 pi (1 - |v|/L)_+ supported in [-L, L]. Standard.
claims.rationale: Makes the contribution of a lattice of real points to the one-sided density an exact constant, against which clusters of off-line pairs are compared.

claims.summary: One-sided density with the Fejer kernel, N simple off-line pairs at heights gamma_0 + j pi/L and one distance delta, b = delta L: |P(x - L)| <= 1/cos(pi x/(2L)) for 0 <= x < L and |G(tau)| <= (1 + 3 pi^2/(2 b^2) + N (1 + b/2) e^(-b/2))/delta^2 for all tau, so at this length N = o(e^(b/2)/b) simple pairs give a negative part no larger than 1 + o(1) times one pair's bound.
claims.assessment: Working proof: the exponential sum is a geometric series with ratio -e^(-i pi x/L). An upper bound at the resonant length only.
claims.rationale: Shows the negative part of the one-sided density does not scale with the number of off-line pairs at a resonant length.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

claims.summary: One-sided density with the Fejer kernel: for k+1 off-line pairs at heights gamma_0 + j pi/L with multiplicities binom(k, j) at one distance delta, |G| <= (k+1)! (pi/b)^k/delta^2 and D_off >= -(2 e^b/(L delta^2)) (k+1)! (pi/b)^k - 6 * 2^k/(L delta^2); with real points on a lattice of spacing s <= 2 pi/L the whole density is nonnegative once 2 pi/s is at least that bound, which for k = floor(b/pi) is at most (2 e^2/(L delta^2)) (b/pi + 1)^(3/2) e^((1 - 1/pi) b) + 6 * 2^(b/pi)/(L delta^2).
claims.assessment: Working proof: the exponential sum is (1 + q)^k with |1 + q| <= pi x/L. With real density l/(2 pi), for each length with b up to about 1.47 log l (asymptotically) the cluster built for that length is hidden at it, where a single pair shows from about log l; its multiplicities are at most l^0.32 there. One cluster per length; not shown that a fixed cluster hides at shorter lengths, that the family shows soon after, or that no admissible cluster hides longer.
claims.rationale: In the model a test of the one-sided density at a single length must use a length exceeding the single-pair length by a factor of at least about 1.47, asymptotically, to see every cluster with multiplicities up to the local count; a lower bound only.
claims.next_action: Decide whether a family with bounded multiplicities hides up to lengths of order log T.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

claims.summary: One-sided density with the Fejer kernel, n >= 2 off-line pairs at one distance delta with total multiplicity M and height span W, b = delta L >= 3: some x in [1/(2 delta), 2/delta] has |P(x - L)| >= p = M/(2 e b)^n, and J = int_0^inf x^2 e^(-2 delta x) |P(x - L)|^2 dx >= (0.073/delta^2)(p^2/4) min(p/(M W), 3/(4 delta)); no condition on the gaps.
claims.assessment: Working proof from the gap-free power sum bound applied at n sample points. The bound counts every off-line pair of the configuration, not those near one height, and through the earlier constant gives sup Re G only of order (2 e b)^(-6n).
claims.rationale: Gives the cluster negativity constant explicitly in terms of the number of pairs, their multiplicity, span and the length, as the route review's test asked, though not locally.
claims.next_action: A local version in which pairs far from the height tested do not count.
